ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the oath of the chargers in Surah Al-Adiyat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a metaphor for the rapidity of divine judgment, where the 'snorting' of the chargers symbolizes the intense preparation and urgency of the soul before the Hereafter. Scholars highlight the contrast between the physical speed of the horses and the spiritual speed at which deeds are recorded, emphasizing that the disbelievers' denial will not delay their reckoning. This imagery serves as a powerful reminder of the inevitability of accountability, a core tenet in both Quranic and Hadith literature regarding the Day of Resurrection.
